acceptance: update_item with an empty string clears a non-empty optional text field and records an update operation; a test covers it.
A request that changes nothing still returns E_STATE.
description: `update_item` with `context` set to an empty value on an item whose context is non-empty returns `E_STATE` `operation produced no state change`, so the field cannot be cleared. Observed 2026-10-21 on `oracle-local-b6-drop-in-repo-engine` (context set by mistake; restoring it to empty was refused). That item has since been dropped. Seen for `context`; other optional text fields untested.
